ITodoListTodo.IRequest.description:
Query parameters for filtering, searching, and paginating todo lists.

Supports flexible result filtering through completion status, priority level, and full-text search across todo content. Pagination parameters control list size and traversal. Sorting parameters enable users to organize results by various dimensions including creation date, due date, priority, or alphabetical order.

All parameters are optional. Omitted filters return all matching records; default pagination uses page 1 with limit 20; default sort uses creation date descending (newest first). Combine parameters to create custom todo list views matching user preferences and use cases.

title.description: Todo task title for update. The title describes what the todo is about and must be 1-255 characters after whitespace trimming. Only include this field if you want to change the title; omit to keep the existing title unchanged.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task. Provides additional context or notes beyond the title. Can be up to 5000 characters. Set to null to clear the description and remove this optional field. Omit this field entirely to retain the existing description value.

completed.description: Completion status toggle. Set to true to mark the todo as complete (system automatically records completion timestamp in completed_at field). Set to false to revert to incomplete status (system clears the completed_at timestamp). Omit this field to keep the current completion status unchanged.

priority.description: Priority level for this todo task. Valid values are 'low', 'medium', or 'high'. Set to null to clear the priority setting and remove any priority classification. Omit this field to preserve the existing priority value.

due_date.description: Optional due date for completing this todo in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2025-12-31T23:59:59Z'). Must be today or in the future; past dates are rejected by validation. Set to null to clear the due date and remove any deadline. Omit this field to keep the existing due date unchanged.

ITodoListTodo.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating an existing todo item with partial field support.

All fields are optional for update operations. Include only the fields you want to modify; omitted fields retain their existing values. This enables partial updates where clients can change specific fields without affecting others.

The system automatically updates the modified timestamp (updated_at) whenever any field is changed. Special timestamp handling applies to completion status changes: when marked complete (completed = true), the system records the completion time in completed_at; when marked incomplete (completed = false), completed_at is cleared to null.

Cannot update immutable fields (id, user_id, created_at) as these are system-managed and represent ownership and audit trail information. Used in PUT or PATCH operations to modify existing todos owned by the authenticated user.

Examples: '10000' for integer values, 'true' for boolean flags, 'production' for string environment names, '3.14' for floating-point numbers.

value_type.description: Data type designation for the configuration value. Must be one of: 'string', 'integer', 'boolean', or 'float'. The application uses this to properly parse and convert config_value to the appropriate runtime type for processing. This ensures type safety when interpreting configuration settings and validating values.

Helps the operations team understand what this setting controls, when it should be modified, and any constraints or guidelines for acceptable values. This field is optional and may be null if no documentation has been provided.

version.description: Version number tracking all changes to this configuration entry. Provides an audit trail enabling operations teams to understand the evolution of configuration changes over time.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was initially created in UTC timezone. This value is immutable after creation and serves as the baseline for the audit trail. Recorded in ISO 8601 format and used for historical tracking and compliance purposes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last modified in UTC timezone. Updated automatically whenever the config_value, description, or other mutable fields change. Enables operations teams to see exactly when the most recent configuration update occurred. Recorded in ISO 8601 format.

ITodoListSystemConfig.description:
System configuration entry representing a single operational setting, feature flag, or deployment-specific parameter.

This entity stores system-wide configuration that controls application behavior without requiring code changes or database schema migrations. Each configuration entry is identified by a unique key (like 'max_todos_per_user' or 'deployment_environment') and contains a string value along with type information ('string', 'integer', 'boolean', 'float') to enable proper parsing and type conversion.

Configuration entries maintain version numbers that increment on updates, creating a complete audit trail of all changes. Timestamps track when entries are created and last modified, enabling operations teams to understand the full history of configuration evolution and identify when changes occurred.

The configuration system provides a flexible, extensible way to manage system-wide settings. It is commonly used for feature flags (enable/disable features), operational parameters (timeouts, limits), and deployment-specific values (environment names, API endpoints) that need to be adjusted without code changes.

ITodoListSystemConfig.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new system configuration entry.

Accepts the configuration key, value (as string), value type designation, and optional description. The system automatically assigns a unique identifier, sets the initial version to 1, and generates creation/modification timestamps in UTC.

The configuration key must be unique; attempting to create a configuration with a key that already exists will result in a conflict error. The provided value will be validated against the specified value_type when stored.

Used to retrieve specific pages of configuration entries when the total result set exceeds the page size limit. Page numbers are 1-indexed.

limit.description:
Maximum number of configuration entries to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

Defines the page size for pagination. Smaller limits return fewer items per page, larger limits return more items per page (up to the maximum of 100).

search.description:

Optional field. If not provided, all configuration entries are included before other filters are applied.

ITodoListSystemConfiguration.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and filter parameters for querying system configuration entries.

Submit this data to the PATCH /todoList/user/systemConfigurations endpoint to search, filter, and paginate through system configuration entries.

Pagination is required: specify page number and limit (items per page). Optional search and filter parameters can be used to narrow down results by config_key substring, value type, version number, or sort order.

The operation returns paginated results with total count, current page, and total pages available. All configuration entries matching the criteria are included in the response.

id.description: Primary key uniquely identifying this system configuration entry. Used to reference specific configuration records in audit logs and configuration history.

config_key.description: Unique configuration key identifier. Examples: 'max_todos_per_user', 'enable_feature_flag_xyz', 'deployment_environment', 'token_expiration_minutes'. Used to lookup specific configuration values by name.

config_value.description: Configuration value as string. The actual value is stored as string for flexibility; type conversion is handled by the application based on the value_type field. Examples: '10000', 'true', 'production', '900'.

version.description: Version number of this configuration entry. Incremented each time the value is updated. Starts at 1 for new entries. Enables tracking of configuration evolution over time.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was initially created in UTC. Immutable after creation. Used for audit trail and history tracking of when the configuration was first added.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last modified in UTC. Updated whenever the config_value or other fields change. Used to track the most recent configuration updates.

ITodoListSystemConfiguration.description:
System-wide configuration and metadata storage for the Todo List application.

Represents operational settings, feature flags, and deployment-specific configuration that applies across the entire system. Configuration entries are stored as key-value pairs with type information and versioning, enabling flexible management of system behavior without database schema migrations.

Each configuration entry has a unique key identifier used for lookups, a string value that is parsed according to its type (string, integer, boolean, or float), and optional human-readable description. Version tracking enables audit trails of configuration changes, and timestamps record when entries are created and modified.

Configuration changes are subject to authorization checks ensuring only administrators can modify system settings. This table is fundamental to system administration and controls critical application behavior including feature flags, performance parameters, and deployment-specific values.

config_value.description: New configuration value as string. Must be compatible with the specified value_type field. Will be parsed by the application according to value_type to ensure correctness.

description.description: Updated human-readable description explaining the purpose and usage of this configuration setting. Optional field - can be omitted to leave description unchanged. Helps operations teams understand what this setting controls.

ITodoListSystemConfiguration.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a system configuration entry.

Allows modification of the configuration value and optional description. The version number is automatically incremented by the system to track configuration changes. Validation ensures the provided config_value is compatible with the configuration's specified value_type before accepting the update.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

ITodoListTokenBlacklist.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.
